Let $s$ be the length of one edge of the new cube. The volume of the new cube is $s^3$, so we have $s^3 = 27$.
Taking the cube root of both sides, we get $s = \sqrt[3]{27} = 3$.
Therefore, the length of one edge of the new cube is 3 centimeters.
